description: This file is a Node.js script that acts as a wrapper to reliably start an Expo development server in preview or CI environments. It manages environment variables, sets up a health check server, ensures dependencies like ngrok are installed, sanitizes command-line arguments, and spawns the Expo process with appropriate configurations.

methods.name: isCIMode
methods.description: Checks if the script is running in CI mode based on environment variables.

methods.name: startHealthcheckServer
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server on a specified port to serve health check responses.

methods.name: rimrafSafe
methods.description: Safely removes a directory or file if it exists.

methods.name: resetMetroAndExpoCaches
methods.description: Resets specific cache directories related to Metro bundler and Expo.

methods.name: resolveHostMode
methods.description: Determines the host mode ('lan', 'tunnel', 'localhost') based on environment variables.

methods.name: sanitizeIncomingArgs
methods.description: Sanitizes command-line arguments to remove certain flags and inline values.

methods.name: ensureNgrokDependencyIfTunnel
methods.description: Checks and installs the @expo/ngrok dependency if needed for tunnel mode.

methods.name: buildArgs
methods.description: Builds the argument list for spawning the Expo start command.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main function that sets up health check server, ensures dependencies, resets caches, and spawns the Expo process.
